parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular, slightly domed cover made of stainless steel that fits on top of the kettle.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the kettle to retain heat and prevent water from spilling or evaporating during boiling.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant plastic attached to the top of the kettle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely lift and pour the kettle without touching the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel with a spout for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water and conducts heat efficiently for boiling.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the main structure of the kettle.
